clips.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is a young Chinese woman in a coral running jacket, ponytail, wireless earbuds, energetic and focused.

integrated_multimodal_description:
Early morning on a riverside concrete promenade; the runner in the coral jacket jogs toward camera at a steady pace, breath visible in cool air, soft golden sunrise raking across the water and long shadows stretching over the pavement; the camera tracks backward smoothly at chest height keeping her centered.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous ambient: light riverside wind, her rhythmic footsteps on concrete, faint distant city hum, birds occasionally.

dialogue_and_sound_effects:
She speaks in Mandarin Chinese in a light, breathy voice between breaths: "今天的第五公里，冲一下。"

non_diegetic_music:
None. No background music, no score, no melodic instrument of any kind. This clip is delivered dry (dialogue/VO + ambience only); music will be added in post-production.

camera_and_shot:
Medium shot, steadicam tracking backward, chest height, 5 seconds.
